persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Put our fox mascot in three separate square pictures: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. Keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, with the same flat cartoon style as the attachment. No text.
bank.Character reference: The fox in mascot-fox.png; preserve its face, markings, proportions and orange hoodie.
bank.Scenes and output count: Three separate pictures: cycling in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree.
bank.Style and size: Square, flat cartoon illustrations matching the attachment; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: I'd like you to make some pictures of our fox mascot, using this attached fox pic as the reference. I'm quite attached to this little character, so I'm a bit nervous about it looking like a different fox from one scene to the next. What I have in mind is three separate square pictures: one of the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree. Please keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, and use the same flat cartoon style as the attached pic. I just think it would be lovely to see the mascot doing these everyday things. Please don't put any text in any of the pictures.
